disambiguation: It focuses on manually created source sets for grounding LLM chats, rather than automatically indexing the entire vault.
extras: Currently limited to Markdown files; no support for images, PDFs, or canvases.
intentEvidence: This plugin focuses on a specific way of AI integration: manually created source sets that an LLM chat is grounded in.
motivation: The author wanted a flexible, configurable, and tweakable AI integration solution that is native to Obsidian.
problem: Standard RAG over an entire vault can be expensive, slow, and less accurate than grounding LLM conversations in specific, manually curated sets of notes.
summary: LLM Workspace allows users to ground Large Language Model conversations in manually selected sets of notes within Obsidian.
